title: Catalytic system-controlled divergent reactions of pyrazolidinones with 3-alkynyl-3-hydroxyisoindolinones to construct diversified nitrogen-containing heterocyclic scaffolds
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21872-21878
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01992C, Paper
Open Access

Zhenwei Zhang, Xiaoxue Zhang, Hao Wang, Geyao Xie, Yu Zhou
A catalytic system-controlled divergent reaction was reported to construct three distinct nitrogen-containing heterocycles from readily available starting materials via a precise chemical bond activation and annulation cascade.
